senses.gloss: prefix (b. h.) unto, to, toward, for; (before infinitive of verbs) to.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 1:1">Pes. I, 1</cite> <he>אור לארבעה וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A00842"><he>אוֹר</he> II</cite>.—<cite ref="L00154"><he>לְהַבָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="L00033"><he>לַבָּא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="B00007"><he>בָּא</he> III</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:1">Ber. I, 1</cite> <he>לֶאֱכוֹל</he> to eat; <he>לִקְרוֹת</he> to read; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>לְיוֹם אחד</he> to one day, i.e. within one day (until morning).
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:3">Zeb. V, 3</cite> <he>ליום ולילה וכ׳</he> within a day and a night until midnight (v. comment.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:3">Ib.</cite> <he>לפנים מן וכ׳</he> inside of the curtains.
Ib. 13ᵃ ולרבי נמי וכ׳ but as to Rabbi’s opinion, might not also argument be raised &c.?; a. v. fr.—With personal pronouns: לִי to me, לְךָ, לְכָה, לָךְ; Ch. לִיךְ &c.—
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 3:17">Ex. R. s. 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="F00014"><he>וַדַּאי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 2b:3">Ber. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>לא שמיע לְהוּ</he> was unknown to them.—Chald.: <he>לִיתְנִי</he> (v. <cite ref="V00743"><he>תְּנִי</he></cite>) let the text read; <cite ref="L00478"><he>לֵימָא</he></cite> (v. <cite ref="A01964"><he>אֲמָא</he></cite>) let him say. Ib. 2ᵃ, sq.; a. v. fr.
